OctoCAT Supply: The demo supply-chain management application: Express + SQLite API in api/ and React + Vite + Tailwind UI in frontend/.
Supplier: OctoCAT Supply domain entity: a company that provides products; linked to products and deliveries.
Headquarters / Branch: OctoCAT Supply domain entities: a customer's head office and its branch locations that place orders.
Order / Order detail / Delivery: OctoCAT Supply domain flow: branches place orders with line items (order details) that are fulfilled by deliveries.
